title: The pen rewrite (updatedContent) is computed once from the pre-mutation read an…
body: The pen rewrite (updatedContent) is computed once from the pre-mutation read and reused verbatim across writeIssueFile's CAS retries, whereas the prior two-commit path re-read the pen fresh after the issue commit. On a CAS retry triggered by a concurrent main-advancing suggestion mutation, the stale updatedContent could clobber the concurrent change. This is an accepted trade-off per the spec (id-independent content, parity with the prior two-commit code) and promote is operator-single-threaded in practice, so the atomicity win dominates. Non-blocking; noted for awareness.
